# Cycles essay outline

The essay on cycles has three strands that I want to braid rather than stack.

## Strands

- Debt: [[Long debt cycle]], the [[Minsky moment]] and [[Deleveraging]].
- Commodities: [[Commodity supercycle]] and the [[Capex cycle in mining]].
- Technology: [[Technology surges]] and [[Kondratiev waves|long waves]].

## Open tasks

- [ ] Work out whether the three cycles share one clock or only rhyme
- [ ] Write the paragraph on why every generation forgets the last bust

See also [[Notes/Cycles/Index]].
